xp_session.description: XP for logging a session (allowed 0–200, whole numbers)

xp_per_effort.description: XP per effort point of work done (allowed 0–50)

xp_verified.description: Bonus XP per skill proven in a Skill Check (allowed 0–500, whole numbers)

xp_record.description: Bonus XP per personal record (allowed 0–200, whole numbers)

xp_stage_up.description: Bonus XP for accepting a step up to a new stage (allowed 0–1000, whole numbers)

ease_up_early.description: Share of the remaining work "I am tired" cuts before 35% through (allowed 0.05–0.8)

fatigue_full_until.description: Too hard / skips count fully up to this far through a session (allowed 0–0.95)

fatigue_floor_from.description: …and count least from this far through (allowed 0.05–1)

balance_headroom.description: Sessions may exceed recent capacity by this factor (allowed 1–2)

tired_sessions_needed.description: Times you ran out of energy recently before sessions are balanced (allowed 1–6, whole numbers)

feature_ai_coach.description: Show the AI coach chat on the Coach tab
